title: feat(web): use ui lib's context menu for albums page
body: ## Description Use the UI lib's `ContextMenu` for the albums page, over the old 'right click menu'. Migrates three actions to the album service. I've kept the existing right-click behavior (though the UI component has no built-in functionality for that) to keep the scope of the PR to refactoring only, but because it's the only place in Immich that we use the `oncontextmenu` handler AFAIK, it might make sense to just remove that behavior. ## How Has This Been Tested? | Before | After | |---|---| | | | | | | | | | ## Please describe to which degree, if any, an LLM was used in creating this pull request.
